prerequisites.title: X developer account and app
prerequisites.detail: Create an app in the Developer Console and set its authentication to OAuth 2.0. OAuth 2.0 works with API v2 only.

prerequisites.title: Privacy policy and terms of service
prerequisites.detail: Link both in the developer dashboard; a blog says skipping them risks delays or rejection.

prerequisites.title: Confidential client type
prerequisites.detail: Choose Web App or Automated App/bot to receive a Client Secret. Native and single-page apps are public clients with no secret.

steps.title: Create X app and enable OAuth 2.0
steps.detail: Log in to the Developer Console, create the app, pick a confidential client type, and enable OAuth 2.0 in the authentication settings.
steps.done_when: Client ID and Client Secret are visible in Keys and Tokens.

steps.title: Draft scope list and justifications
steps.detail: Request only needed scopes, and add offline.access if you need refresh tokens. Write a plain explanation for each write or DM scope.
steps.done_when: A scope list with justifications exists.

steps.title: Add privacy policy and terms links
steps.detail: Link both in the developer dashboard.
steps.done_when: Both links are saved in the dashboard.

steps.title: Copy callback URL from Composio dashboard
steps.detail: Take the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard and check it is HTTPS and has no trailing-slash mismatch. If you proxy through your own domain, use that proxy URL instead.
steps.done_when: Callback string is ready to paste.

steps.title: Register callback URL in X app
steps.detail: Add the callback URL exactly in the app settings. You can add a localhost URL for development alongside it.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a custom auth config through Composio's API with your client ID, secret and scopes.

steps.title: Test connection with a test user
steps.detail: Connect an account and confirm calls work. Check that the code is exchanged within 30 seconds and that a refresh token arrives.
steps.done_when: Connected account makes a successful API call.

steps.title: Provider security review, if triggered
steps.detail: Duration and exact process were not found. Watch for a 403 at the callback that points to elevated access.
steps.done_when: Write/DM scopes work for outside users.

traps.title: Access tokens die after two hours
traps.detail: Without the offline.access scope there is no refresh token, so users must reconnect after two hours.

traps.title: Callback URL must match exactly
traps.detail: Protocol, slashes and trailing slash must all match what is registered in the app.

traps.title: Composio callback domain cannot be verified by you
traps.detail: X requires exact-match callbacks. Composio's domain is not yours, so the callback is routed through your own domain via a 302 redirect proxy to Composio. Do not fetch it server-side.

traps.title: Posting and DMs need user context
traps.detail: App-only tokens cannot post or read DMs. Use the user OAuth flow.

traps.title: Billing is separate from rate limits
traps.detail: X API usage is charged per data retrieved, so you can stay within limits and still pay.

blockers.what_it_means: A blog says some scopes may need elevated access.
blockers.what_to_do: Re-check requested scopes, apply for elevated access if required, or start with read-only scopes.
blockers.agent_can_help: Compare requested scopes against what the agent needs and trim them.

blockers.what_it_means: The redirect URI does not exactly match one registered in the app.
blockers.what_to_do: Copy the exact URI from the Composio dashboard or your proxy and re-register it.
blockers.agent_can_help: Diff the sent redirect_uri against the registered one.
